# Raw Block

Raw Block is a Bitcoin exploration and protocol-learning workspace that combines:
- live explorer views (blocks, mempool, fees, miners, network, vitals)
- educational labs (Script, Taproot, Keys, Hashing, Consensus)
- research registries (vulnerabilities, attack models, assumptions, policy vs consensus)

Primary site: https://www.rawblock.net
Repository: https://github.com/leanlp/rawblock

## Core sections
- Home: https://www.rawblock.net/
- About & Trust: https://www.rawblock.net/about
- Explorer / Network: https://www.rawblock.net/explorer/network
- Explorer / Blocks: https://www.rawblock.net/explorer/blocks
- Explorer / Decoder: https://www.rawblock.net/explorer/decoder
- Explorer / Rich List: https://www.rawblock.net/explorer/rich-list

- Taproot Playground: https://www.rawblock.net/lab/taproot
- Consensus Debugger: https://www.rawblock.net/lab/consensus
- Mempool Simulator: https://www.rawblock.net/game/mempool

## Data and source policy
- Primary data comes from Raw Block hosted Bitcoin infrastructure (node/indexers/gateway).
- Some modules may use explicit fallback providers when local data is unavailable.
- UI badges and labels indicate fallback or snapshot status when available.

- API gateway (public endpoints vary): https://apigoland.rawblock.net/
